sample_metadata.expected_output_shape: A single integer with no units or surrounding prose.
sample_metadata.input: Train A leaves a station heading east at 60 kilometers per hour. Two hours after Train A departs, Train B leaves the same station heading east on the same track at 90 kilometers per hour. How many hours after Train B departs does Train B catch up to Train A?
sample_metadata.quality_rubric_notes: Correct answer is exactly 4 (Train A has a 120 km head start; closing speed is 30 km/h; time to close = 4 hours). The integer 4 must be the only number in the response.
